articles.title: MONY Group (LSE:MONY) Stock May Trade At A 43% Discount On Cash Flow
articles.summary: MONY Group shares have delivered a solid multi year gain, which raises a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today: Is the current £2.006 price properly backed by the cash the business is expected to generate? Over the last 5 years the share price has risen 27.6%, which makes it important to check whether that performance lines up with the strength and durability of MONY Group's cash flows.
